description: Groups of users with a role each (a team, a client), for rows that belong to a group: neblla.db.save(data, { table, group }). Roles and their rights per table are declared with neblla_update_app({ roles }). Actions: "create" { name }, "delete" { name } (with its members; its rows stay), "add" { group, user, role } (user: the user id in the app, as neblla_list_users gives it; adding again changes the role), "remove" { group, user }, "list" (the groups, or { group } its members), "of" { user } (their groups). An employee and a client are different roles in the same group. Also from the admin API and from the developer's server (never a Fog).
name: neblla_group
